editor.partial: Elevation gain is approximate: some sections have no measured elevation yet.

editor.helpHints: Click the map: add a point. Click the line: insert a point; drag the line: insert and place a point in one move. Drag a point: move it. Click or right-click a point: its actions. Right-click the line: segment actions. Hover: km, altitude and grade. Magnet: a point placed near a single or the track snaps onto it; hold Alt (or Shift) to place it freely.

snap.label: Magnet
snap.hint: A point placed near a single or your track snaps onto it. Out of reach, it stays free.

rider.label: Rider
rider.hint: Routing avoids climbs steeper than 4% on pedal power, 8% on an e-bike.

preview.pickDate: Pick a date to see the conditions (weather, wildfire, hunting).
